decision: Architect decision 2026-11-09 (RECON 2026-10-uo-real-data §9 row 4b): 乗降客数推移 sums a fixed panel of S12 rows over the years below; 2019 is a gap; values are S12's as published — no adjustment, no re-dating.
rule: A unit is one S12 row, or the rows of one station whose figures S12 moves between each other inside one ward. It is in the panel when every panel year has a figure on its rows (重複コード 1, データ有無コード 1, value above 0), none of those years falls in a reason class below, and what its rows contain does not change between the first and the last panel year.

reasonClasses.repeat_or_lag: the year's value repeats another year's, or is not that year's figure
reasonClasses.definition_change: what the row contains changes (another line or operator joins or leaves it, the figure moves to another row, or the row was 非公開)
reasonClasses.opened_or_closed: the station opened or closed inside the panel years
reasonClasses.entry_error: the value differs from the figure of its year (a digit, a copy of another row's value)
reasonClasses.unexplained: the value departs from the row's other years and from the operator's figure for no stated reason

evidence: The checks behind every class — each row against the operators' own published figures — are recorded outside this repository (the real-data plan's evidence folder, ridership-trend/: REPORT-pr4b-ridership-trend.md, flagged-cases.csv). No operator figure is committed here.

excerpt.rowRef: feature = 1-based position in the excerpt's features; code / operator / line / station = S12_001c / S12_002 / S12_003 / S12_001 of that feature
